purpose: Reassert the already-created native colour and full-size depth/stencil pair immediately before Skyrim submits deferred Scaleform HUD draws
replacement: encodeCallSiteReplacement to a process-lifetime near relay ending in the pinned RazKolbas deferredUiFlushProxy; the proxy reasserts the native RTV plus existing display-sized DSV, then calls the original target exactly once
abi: Exact caller bytes load the UI renderer owner into RCX. The exact fc3300 body dereferences renderer +0x18 and calls virtual slot +0x28, CommonLibSSE Scaleform Renderer::EndFrame. The wrapper return is not consumed.
activation: Prepared with the world and menu relays, then installed at SKSEPlugin_Load after exact executable hash, image size, caller, target and five-byte CALL validation. Any later coupled-write failure restores already-installed owned CALLs before startup resumes.
lifetime: Callback DLL is pinned; relay and forwarding state remain reachable for process lifetime. No hot unpatch.
recovery: The callback always forwards the original wrapper. A state-reassertion failure is logged and leaves the original flush intact. SafeMode or this disabled patch ID prevents the coupled render hooks on the next launch.
